nested char span (standard view).text \"~one \"@1 copy the text at the ca: A paste over the separator after `\nd` and the first content byte: removing the annotation's mark over that byte marks the span changed, so the opener-separator sync (`$syncOpenerSeparators`) puts the separator back in front of the pasted space while the edit is pending (`\nd` NBSP + ` one`). With no annotation only the text changes, the sync does not run on the span, and the pasted space stands as the separator until the settle. Settled, the two are the same.
